panels.scene: Simple pastel office background. On the left, Nyang_daeri sits at his desk, resting his cheek on one paw with a hungry, dreamy expression. On the right, Ham_jumin nervously fidgets with his paws while checking the clock.

On the far right, Meong_bujang suddenly appears, standing proudly with hands on his hips and a wide, beaming smile. In the center, Ham_jumin flinches slightly. On the left, Nyang_daeri perks his ears up with hopeful green eyes.
Split focus. On the left, Nyang_daeri happily raises a paw with sparkling eyes. On the right, Meong_bujang enthusiastically gives a thumbs up, completely shouting his own choice without listening.

Inside a restaurant at a wooden table. On the right, Meong_bujang is happily eating from a boiling hot stone pot with steam rising. On the left, Nyang_daeri sits with drooping ears and a completely soul-drained expression, cautiously blowing on a hot spoon.
